CredentialDocument.title: CredentialDocument
CredentialDocument.description: Metadata record for an uploaded portfolio credential such as a Resume, Project Report, Certificate, or Academic Transcript.

name.description: Display name assigned by the portfolio owner.

category.description: Credential classification. Only Resume items allow visitor downloads.

mimeType.description: Validated MIME type for in-browser preview.

fileSize.description: Total file size in bytes (max 10 MB).

chunkCount.description: Number of base64 chunks stored in the chunks subcollection.

notes.description: Optional issuer, date, or context note.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the portfolio owner who uploaded the item.

CredentialChunk.title: CredentialChunk
CredentialChunk.description: Base64 payload chunk belonging to a parent CredentialDocument for reliable multi-megabyte storage.

data.description: Base64-encoded slice of the uploaded credential file.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the parent CredentialDocument ownerUid.

/credentials/{credentialId}.description: Publicly readable portfolio credential metadata; writes strictly restricted to the verified owner.

/credentials/{credentialId}/chunks/{chun.description: Chunked file content for in-website preview (and Resume-only download), gated by parent CredentialDocument.
